# Web-spider profiles

Pacing presets for the background crawler that grounds the knowledge base in a watchlist of sites. Enabled with ``--spider``; bare use takes ``gentle``, and ``KEY=VALUE`` entries override any field.

Registry: ``praxis.SPIDER_REGISTRY`` (2 entries)

## `gentle`

Value: `{'max_sites': 16, 'max_pages_per_site': 50, 'max_kb_pages': 200, 'tick_seconds': 300, 'domain_seconds': 1800, 'max_page_bytes': 2097152, 'revisit_days': 7.0}`

## `ghost`

Value: `{'max_sites': 23, 'max_pages_per_site': 23, 'max_kb_pages': 230, 'tick_seconds': 15, 'domain_seconds': 60, 'max_page_bytes': 2097152, 'revisit_days': 0.25}`
